commands: if ! command -v dotnet >/dev/null 2>&1; then curl -fsSL https://dot.net/v1/dotnet-install.sh -o /tmp/dotnet-install.sh; bash /tmp/dotnet-install.sh --channel 8.0 --install-dir /usr/share/dotnet; ln -sfn /usr/share/dotnet/dotnet /usr/local/bin/dotnet; fi
cd /opt/schlieren && git rev-parse --short HEAD && git branch --show-current
